sections.candidate: Administrator receives applications, issues permits/certificates, examines premises, inspects and enforces zoning with stated exceptions for Part14. No specific electrical issuing authority or equivalence between certificate types established.

Zoning permit before land/structure construction, modification or conversion. No commencement within one year expires permit; one-year abandonment after commencement triggers printed removal procedure, not automated enforcement. Applicant may request one additional year from Planning Commission/Council before original expiration with justification. Do not silently extend1278 certificate.

Zoning certificate of occupancy after administrator inspection for newly erected/changed/converted/enlarged premises/use; printed part of building permit. Temporary partial occupancy possible under administrator rules. Business/industrial ownership/tenancy transfer provision has seller-business continuation exception. Fees Council-established; sign-only applicability unresolved.

IBI designated official electrical wiring inspection organization until Council provides otherwise; inspections without cost to CITY, not applicant fee exemption. History Resolution395-1948 April7 1948. Current delegation unapproved; section does not separately identify permit issuer.
Printed1990 NEC adoption is legacy evidence only, not current code edition approval.

supporting_sources.candidate: County department serves unincorporated/contract jurisdictions and says IBI handles electrical permits/inspections. This general statement does not prove Reading is within county service scope.

General provider guidance does not prove Reading permit delegation; legacy technical references not current code approval.
